meta_title: APN Pro Plumb | 24Hr Emergency Plumber Newcastle
meta_description: APN Pro Plumb 24Hr Emergency Ltd — Newcastle's trusted emergency plumber. Fast response, Gas Safe registered, available round the clock. Call us today.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — 24/7 Emergency Plumbing Newcastle
hero_subhead: Burst pipe, boiler breakdown, or leak at midnight — we're on our way fast, day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing Services Across Newcastle & Tyne and Wear
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to full bathroom installations, we handle every plumbing challenge with speed, skill, and a tidy finish.

services.title: 24Hr Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, severe leaks, or sudden water damage — we respond fast any time of day or night. Our emergency team aims to reach you within 60 minutes anywhere in Newcastle.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Servicing
services.desc: Boiler breakdowns are diagnosed and repaired by our Gas Safe registered engineers, restoring your heating and hot water as quickly as possible. Annual servicing also available to keep your boiler running safely all year.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Hidden leaks can cause costly damage if left unchecked. We use professional equipment to locate and fix leaks quickly, minimising disruption to your property.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: From full suite replacements to walk-in shower conversions, we manage every aspect of your bathroom installation to a high standard. All work is left clean, fully functional, and built to last.

services.title: Blocked Drains & Toilets
services.desc: Stubborn blockages cleared efficiently using professional drain-clearing tools and techniques. We remove the blockage, check for underlying causes, and leave everything flowing freely.

services.title: Central Heating Installation & Repairs
services.desc: Whether you need a full central heating system installed or an existing system repaired, our engineers deliver reliable, energy-efficient solutions tailored to your home.

about_pullquote: Every job we take on, we treat that home as if it were our own.
about_para_1: APN Pro Plumb 24Hr Emergency Ltd was founded right here in Newcastle with a single goal: to provide honest, reliable plumbing and heating services that residents could count on at any hour. We built our reputation by showing up promptly, communicating clearly, and never cutting corners — whether it's a routine repair or a midnight emergency.
about_para_2: Our Gas Safe registered engineers bring years of hands-on experience to every job, and our 24-hour availability means you're never left without help when it matters most. Customers throughout Newcastle and the wider Tyne and Wear area return to us time and again because they know the work will be done properly, the price will be fair, and the team will leave their home exactly as they found it.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Called APN Pro Plumb at 2am with a burst pipe and they were at my door within the hour. The engineer was professional, sorted the problem quickly, and the price was completely fair for an emergency callout. Brilliant service — I won't use anyone else.
reviews.author: James R.

reviews.text: My boiler packed in on one of the coldest nights of the year and APN had it back up and running the same evening. Really friendly lad, explained everything clearly, and didn't try to oversell me on anything. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Needed a blocked drain sorting urgently before a family event and they came out at short notice, no fuss. Cleared within 20 minutes and they even checked the other drains while they were here. Genuinely great local company.
reviews.author: David T.
